judge.notes: Three has the clearest hierarchy, strongest scan path, most legible typography, and disciplined whitespace, with diagrams and tables that directly support the decision-path narrative. One is cohesive and polished with useful sequence/gate visuals, but several supporting lines are very small and some compositions feel underfilled. Two has a coherent editorial style and logical progression, but its dense, tiny text and limited visual contrast make the deck harder to read and less compositionally engaging.
